description: Codex-specific hook set. Codex prefers .codex-plugin over .claude-plugin, so this file - not hooks.json - is what it loads. It declares only events Codex supports, and passes --portable so the hook emits the output subset Codex's strict schema accepts (hookEventName + additionalContext only). Wake needs FileChanged + asyncRewake, which Codex does not have, so it is deliberately absent here.
